note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含、通过 XML 校验的 SVG 插画（约 23 KB、110 条路径）：低角度夕阳下的海边，一只鹈鹕骑着复古自行车沿海滩行进，含长喙与下垂喉囊、分层覆羽与深色初级飞羽、踩在脚踏上的蹼足、轮组与链条与曲柄、湿沙镜面倒影、扬沙与速度线。生成后用无头浏览器（Edge headless）截图核对三轮，修复四类缺陷：首版仅 8 根辐条、翼部羽毛以细线表现（读作鱼骨）、鹈鹕身体压在车架上、车把与立管衔接不清；第二版初级飞羽越出体轮廓并横穿车架形成黑色棒状、鞍座与飞羽重合成深色块、双腿过直；第三版将飞羽收进体轮廓、鞍座后移隐藏、腿部改为屈膝踩踏姿态并把蹼足压到脚踏上、补充喙部鼻孔与角质感、增加体块明暗与投影。修复仅涉及几何与取值层面，未引入任何外部资源。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained, XML-valid SVG illustration (about 23 KB, 110 paths): a pelican riding a vintage bicycle along a beach at low sun, with a long bill and a sagging gular pouch, layered coverts and dark primaries, webbed feet on the pedals, wheelset with chain and cranks, a mirror reflection in the wet sand, kicked-up sand and speed lines. Three rounds of headless-browser (Edge headless) screenshot review followed generation, fixing four defect groups: the first pass had only 8 spokes and drew the wing feathers as thin lines that read as a fish skeleton, the pelican's body sat on the frame instead of the seat, and the handlebar did not connect to the stem; in the second pass the dark primaries broke outside the body outline and crossed the frame as a black bar, the saddle merged with the primaries into a dark block, and both legs were too straight; the third pass pulled the primaries back inside the silhouette, moved the saddle out of sight, bent the legs into a pedalling pose with the webbed foot pressed onto the pedal, added a nostril groove and keratin shading to the bill, and added form shading and a cast shadow. The fixes are geometric and value-level only, and no external resource was introduced.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含的 HTML（约 38 KB、998 行；Three.js r160 经 unpkg CDN 引入，几何装配、材质与交互代码全部内联，不使用任何外部资产）：程序化装配的镂空机械表，含主发条盒（约 11.5 圈蓝钢发条、34 齿棘轮与棘爪）、四级轮系（中心轮 26 齿、三番轮 22 齿、四番轮 18 齿、擒纵轮 15 齿，齿形与辐条由代码生成）、瑞士杠杆擒纵（擒纵叉带两枚红宝石瓦）、玫瑰金摆轮与 11 圈蓝钢游丝、三块日内瓦纹夹板（均带开孔）、21 枚红宝石轴承与黄金套筒、微弧蓝宝石镜面（折射率 1.77）、夜光时标与指针、拉丝精钢表壳与抛光表圈以及表冠与表耳；影棚环境由程序化场景经 PMREM 生成，配三点布光、ACES Filmic 色调映射与暗色反光地面。交互：自写轨道控制（拖拽旋转、滚轮缩放）、爆炸视图、悬停标签与点击锁定零件详情面板、自动旋转、机芯运行开关、复位视角；摆轮按 4 Hz 在 ±135° 摆动，擒纵轮每拍步进一齿，轮系与三根指针按传动比联动。生成后用无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader，WebGL2）渲染核对四轮，修复五处缺陷：首版相机距离过近导致表体出画、点光源强度过高造成镜面过曝；蓝宝石镜面使用厚壁 transmission 材质时整块表被磨砂化，改为薄壳透明玻璃并单面渲染；主夹板原为实心圆盘、与「镂空」要求不符，改为六处镂空并把底盖改为深色，使开口读作真实通透；表壳与表耳尺寸偏大、表圈过厚；爆炸视图在正面视角下沿 Z 轴分离不可读，改为爆炸时联动倾斜视角并加大层间距。最终实测 385 个网格、14 个零件组、零运行时错误。展示用参数如实说明：夜光发光强度、指针演示转速为视觉参数，秒针在展示中约以真实速度的 14 倍运行以便观察轮系联动（界面已注明）。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML page (about 38 KB, 998 lines; Three.js r160 via the unpkg CDN, with all assembly, material and interaction code inline and no external assets): a procedurally assembled skeleton mechanical watch with a mainspring barrel (about 11.5 turns of blued-steel mainspring, a 34-tooth ratchet and its click), a four-stage train (centre 26T, third 22T, fourth 18T and a 15-tooth escape wheel, tooth profiles and spokes generated in code), a Swiss lever escapement whose pallet fork carries two ruby stones, a rose-gold balance wheel with an 11-turn blued hairspring, three Cotes de Geneve bridges with openings, 21 ruby jewels in gold chatons, a slightly domed sapphire crystal (refractive index 1.77), luminous markers and hands, a brushed steel case with a polished bezel, crown and lugs; the studio environment is generated by PMREM from a procedural scene, with three-point lighting, ACES Filmic tone mapping and a dark reflective floor. Interaction: custom orbit controls (drag to rotate, wheel to zoom), an exploded view, hover labels and a click-to-pin part detail panel, auto-rotate, a movement run toggle and a view reset; the balance oscillates at 4 Hz over plus or minus 135 degrees, the escape wheel steps one tooth per beat, and the train and the three hands are geared together. Four rounds of headless-browser (Edge with SwiftShader, WebGL2) render review followed generation, fixing five defects: the first pass put the camera too close so the case fell outside the frame, and a point light was bright enough to blow out the specular highlights; the sapphire crystal used a thick transmission material that frosted the whole dial, so it became a thin transparent shell rendered single-sided; the mainplate was a solid disc that contradicted the skeleton brief, so six openings were cut and the caseback was darkened to make them read as real voids; the case and lugs were oversized and the bezel too thick; and the exploded view was unreadable because Z-axis separation is invisible from a face-on camera, so the watch now tilts as it explodes and the layer spacing was increased. Final measurement: 385 meshes, 14 part groups, no runtime errors. Visual parameters are disclosed: the lume emissive intensity and the demo hand speed are visual values, and the seconds hand runs about 14x its real rate in the showcase so the train linkage is observable, as noted in the UI.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为单文件、自包含的 HTML（约 43 KB、1053 行；Three.js r160 经 unpkg CDN 引入，噪声、网格、物理与交互全部内联，不使用任何外部资产）：哈希噪声驱动的可滚动体素世界（分区高度场叠加海岸衰减，实测高度 4–63、海平面 26、地表最大坡度 1 格/格），16 张程序化 canvas 贴图组成的图集、14 种方块与 8 格快捷栏，逐面剔除的区块网格（16×96×16 区块、5 区块视距、按需生成与卸载）与逐顶点环境光遮蔽，第一人称 WASD 与指针锁定环视、重力与跳跃与一格自动上台阶、AABB 分轴碰撞，DDA 体素拾取实现的左键破坏与右键放置，天空渐变穹顶与雾。七类神话造物按 112 格网格确定性分布：浮空神殿（带锥形底座的浮岛）、世界之树、巨石环阵、通天塔、残破柱廊、持杖巨像与地下结晶石窟，实测生成 6 神殿 / 4 神树 / 1 环阵 / 5 塔 / 7 柱廊 / 7 巨像 / 1 石窟。生成后用无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader，WebGL2）实际运行核对，修复五类缺陷：哈希用乘法导致 32 位溢出、噪声与分布退化（通天塔与柱廊生成数为 0），改用 Math.imul 后七类造物齐全；区块生成结果未写回世界表，只剩 3 个区块可渲染；出生点仅按高度公式判定而落在山体内部，改为按世界数据寻找最高且干燥、上下两格无遮挡的列并校验可站立；世界之树树冠原为稀疏壳体，改为实心椭球并按表面概率稀疏；浮空神殿原为 3 层薄板、仰视时读作悬空石板，改为 13 层锥形底座使其成立为浮岛。已知且如实记录的缺陷：在掠射视角下部分方块表面会透出天色的浅蓝缝隙，已排除数据与几何两方面的原因——逐列采样确认每列自底向上连续实心（如 top/solid/gap 均为 33/34/1），线框渲染亦显示面片完整，该现象仅出现在着色渲染中，根因尚未定位；它不影响破坏、放置、碰撞与移动逻辑，按仓库规则作为如实记录的产出提交。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a single-file, self-contained HTML page (about 43 KB, 1053 lines; Three.js r160 via the unpkg CDN, with noise, meshing, physics and interaction all inline and no external assets): a hash-noise scrollable voxel world (partitioned height field with a coastal falloff, measured heights 4-63, sea level 26, maximum surface gradient one block per block), a procedurally painted 16-tile canvas atlas, 14 block types with an eight-slot hotbar, face-culled chunk meshes (16x96x16 chunks, five-chunk view distance, generated and unloaded on demand) with per-vertex ambient occlusion, first-person WASD with pointer-lock look, gravity, jumping and one-block auto step-up, axis-separated AABB collision, DDA voxel picking for left-click break and right-click place, and a gradient sky dome with fog. Seven kinds of mythic structure are distributed deterministically on a 112-block grid: floating temples on tapered islands, world trees, monolith circles, ziggurats, ruined colonnades, staff-bearing colossi and underground crystal caverns; the measured counts are 6 temples, 4 trees, 1 stone circle, 5 towers, 7 colonnades, 7 colossi and 1 cavern. Verification ran the page in a headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader, WebGL2) and fixed five defects: the hash used plain multiplication, overflowing 32 bits and degrading both the noise and the structure distribution (the ziggurat and colonnade counts were zero), which Math.imul fixed once all seven kinds appeared; generated chunks were never written back into the world map, leaving only 3 chunks renderable; the spawn point was chosen from the height formula alone and landed inside a hillside, so it now scans the world data for the highest dry column with two clear blocks of headroom and validates that the player fits; the world tree canopy was a sparse shell and is now a solid ellipsoid thinned by surface probability; and the floating temple was three thin layers that read as a hovering slab from below, replaced by a 13-layer tapered island. One known defect is disclosed as measured: at grazing view angles some block faces let the sky colour through. Both data and geometry were ruled out, since per-column sampling shows every column continuously solid from bedrock up (top/solid/gap readings such as 33/34/1) and a wireframe render shows the faces present; the effect appears only in the shaded pass and the root cause is not yet isolated. It does not affect breaking, placing, collision or movement, and the artifact is submitted as recorded data per the repository rules.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为完整 Vite 工程（根目录 package.json / index.html / src，另附由同一份源码构建的单文件 dist/index.html，离线可直接打开，无任何网络依赖）：约 30 秒的三维科普短片，讲北宋苏颂水运仪象台如何靠水力报时。仪象台由天池与平水壶（恒水位）、枢轮与 12 只受水壶、天关与天衡擒纵、昼夜机轮与木人、顶层浑象与浑仪组成。所有机械运动由物理引擎（cannon-es）实时积分：受水壶在进水弧内累积水量并对轮体施加随位置变化的重量，周向分量形成驱动力矩；天关为带铰链约束的刚体，轮辐上的销推动它摆开再复位，形成逐格放行；轮轴经传动带动昼夜机轮与浑象转动；摆轮式的限速与单向棘轮保证转速稳定且不倒转。镜头与字幕按时间轴编排（此项按题目许可不受物理约束）。声音全部用 Web Audio 在运行时合成：水流带通噪声、木质擒纵声、钟、鼓与低频持续音。已验证：npm run build 通过，单文件产物 586 KB；无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader）完整播放至 31 秒，字幕按七段依次切换，无页面错误、无失败请求，实测枢轮角速度约 1.19 rad/s、浑象与昼夜机轮同步转动。生成后修复七处缺陷：(1) 圆柱碰撞体的朝向按 Z 轴旋转设置，导致其轴向落在轮平面内，枢轮转到恰好 90° 时硬性卡死，改为绕 X 轴旋转使轴向与轮轴一致；(2) 天关原为竖直悬挂、铰点正对销的运动轨迹，接触法线穿过枢轴、力矩为零而永久锁死，改为 L 形摆杆并将枢轴水平偏置 0.7 格；(3) 摆杆复位时会把轮子顶回，加入单向棘轮项；(4) 水力过强时转速升到 7.7 rad/s，加入限速器把转速稳定在约 1.2 rad/s；(5) 楼层原按 2.25 格一层，直接横切枢轮所在腔体，改为只保留两层甲板让出轮腔；(6) 原封顶屋面把浑象与浑仪压在屋顶内，改为四柱开敞顶棚；(7) 构建改为 vite-plugin-singlefile，使 dist/index.html 单文件离线可运行。透明披露：枢轮到昼夜机轮与浑象的传动采用力矩耦合（比例 + 阻尼）而非齿面接触，这是本作对真实齿轮传动的一种等效替代；机械部分（受水壶、枢轮、擒纵、联动轴）的位移与转角全部来自求解器积分，没有任何关键帧动画或直接设置位置。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a complete Vite project (package.json / index.html / src at the root, plus a single-file dist/index.html built from the same source that opens offline with no network dependency): a roughly 30-second 3D explainer on how Su Song's Northern Song water-driven clock tower told the time. The tower comprises the Tianchi reservoir and the constant-level Pingshuihu tank, the pivot wheel with 12 receiving buckets, the Tianguan/Tianheng escapement, the day-night wheel with its wooden figures, and the celestial globe and armillary sphere on top. Every mechanical motion is integrated in real time by a physics engine (cannon-es): a bucket accumulates water while inside the inlet arc and applies a position-dependent weight to the wheel body, whose tangential component produces the driving torque; the check pallet is a hinged rigid body that the rim pins push aside and that springs back, releasing the wheel a pin at a time; the axle drives the day-night wheel and the globe; a governor and a one-way ratchet keep the rate stable and prevent reverse rotation. Camera and captions are scripted on a timeline, which the brief explicitly exempts from the physics requirement. All sound is synthesised at runtime with the Web Audio API: band-passed water noise, wooden escapement clicks, a bell, a drum and a low drone. Verified: npm run build passes and produces a 586 KB single file; a headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader) played the piece through to 31 seconds with all seven caption cues in order, no page errors and no failed requests, measuring a pivot wheel angular speed of about 1.19 rad/s with the globe and day-night wheel turning in step. Seven defects were fixed after generation: (1) the cylinder collider was oriented by a Z-axis rotation, putting its axis inside the wheel plane and hard-locking the wheel at exactly 90 degrees; rotating about X instead aligned it with the axle; (2) the pallet hung vertically with its pivot directly over the pin path, so the contact normal passed through the pivot, gave zero moment and deadlocked permanently; it became an L-shaped pallet with the pivot offset 0.7 units sideways; (3) the returning pallet pushed the wheel backwards, so a one-way ratchet term was added; (4) with strong water the wheel ran up to 7.7 rad/s, so a governor now holds it near 1.2 rad/s; (5) the storeys were spaced 2.25 units apart and sliced straight through the wheel chamber, so only two decks remain; (6) the closed roof trapped the globe and armillary, replaced by an open canopy on four posts; (7) the build now uses vite-plugin-singlefile so dist/index.html runs offline as one file. Disclosed transparently: the transmission from the pivot wheel to the day-night wheel and the globe uses a torque coupling (ratio plus damping) rather than tooth-face contact, an equivalent stand-in for a real gear train; the mechanical parts (buckets, pivot wheel, escapement, driven shafts) move entirely from solver integration, with no keyframe animation and no directly set positions.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为完整的 Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + three.js 工程（11 个源文件，另附同一份源码构建的单文件 dist/index.html，离线可运行）：浏览器内可玩的 5v5 战术射击原型。地图以 64×64、每格 2 米的瓦片网格雕出 T 出生点、A 大、A 点、中路与可穿过的中门、猫道、B 洞、B 点与 CT 出生点，同一份网格同时驱动碰撞、A* 寻路、Bresenham 视线判定与雷达，因此四者不会互相矛盾。角色为方块拼装的人形，头、躯干、双臂、双腿各自独立并带行走摆动，两阵营配色区分；命中判定分头（伤害×2）、胸、腹、臂（×0.8）、腿（×0.75）五个区。武器为 AK-47 / M4A4 / AWP（右键开镜：FOV 收窄 + 2D 瞄具遮罩）/ Glock-18 / USP-S / 沙鹰 / 匕首，各自有伤害、射速、散布、后坐力、换弹与护甲穿透；第一回合为手枪局（仅默认手枪、无甲），之后发放护甲与步枪。C4 由持包的 T 机器人在包点安放、40 秒引信、玩家按 E 持续 10 秒拆除，回合按清空、爆炸或拆包结算，带击杀播报与比分。AI 为 4 名 CT 队友 + 5 名 T 敌人：每 2–3 秒重算 A* 路径，有视线才开火并带反应散布，进攻方推包安放、防守方前往拆包。HUD 含准星、生命与护甲、动态弹药、击杀播报、雷达小地图、C4 倒计时、开镜遮罩与拆包进度。全部音效由 Web Audio 运行时合成（按武器类别的枪声、换弹、命中、爆头、击杀、安放、爆炸、脚步、回合提示）。已验证：vite build 通过；无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader）实跑，无页面错误，冻结期进入进行期、9 名 AI 沿路径推进、第一人称持枪模型正常渲染。生成后修复四处缺陷：package.json 漏声明 react / react-dom 导致构建无法解析 jsx-runtime；入口改名后 index.html 仍指向 main.jsx；出生点正对墙面而看不到战场，移入中路走廊；第一人称武器模型过大且背光发黑，缩放至 0.52 并加相机附属点光。如实记录的简化：Dust2 为抽象化的瓦片布局而非 1:1 复刻；未实现投掷物与经济系统；AI 不做拉枪线以外的战术协同；玩家固定为防守方。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a complete Vite + React 18 + TypeScript + three.js project (11 source files, plus a single-file dist/index.html built from the same source that runs offline): a browser-playable 5v5 tactical shooter prototype. The map is carved from a 64x64 tile grid of 2 m cells into T spawn, Long A, the A site, Mid with its passable doors, Catwalk, B tunnels, the B site and CT spawn, and that single grid drives collision, A* pathfinding, Bresenham line of sight and the radar, so the four can never disagree. Characters are block-built humanoids with separate head, torso, arms and legs, a walk cycle and distinguishable team colours; hit resolution uses five zones, with the head at twice body damage, chest and stomach at 1, arms at 0.8 and legs at 0.75. The weapons are the AK-47, M4A4, AWP (right-click scope with a narrowed FOV and a 2D scope overlay), Glock-18, USP-S, Desert Eagle and knife, each with its own damage, rate of fire, spread, recoil, reload and armour penetration; round one is a pistol round (default pistol only, no armour) and later rounds issue armour plus rifles. The C4 is planted by the bomb-carrying T bot inside a site, burns a 40-second fuse and is defused by holding E for 10 seconds, with rounds resolved by elimination, detonation or defusal, plus a kill feed and score. The AI is four CT teammates and five T opponents: each recomputes an A* path every 2-3 seconds, only fires with line of sight and an aim spread, pushes and plants on attack and walks to defuse on defence. The HUD carries a crosshair, health and armour, live ammo, the kill feed, a radar minimap, the C4 countdown, the scope overlay and defuse progress. Every sound is synthesised at runtime with the Web Audio API: per-class gunshots, reload, hit, headshot, kill, plant, explosion, footsteps and round stings. Verified: vite build passes; a headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader) ran it with no page errors, advancing from the freeze phase into live play with nine AI actors pathing forward and the first-person weapon model rendering. Four defects were fixed after generation: package.json was missing react and react-dom, so the build could not resolve jsx-runtime; index.html still pointed at main.jsx after the entry was renamed; the spawn faced a wall with no view of the battlefield and was moved into the mid corridor; and the first-person weapon model was oversized and unlit, so it was scaled to 0.52 and given a camera-attached point light. Simplifications recorded as they are: Dust2 is an abstracted tile layout rather than a 1:1 replica, grenades and the economy are not implemented, the AI does no tactical coordination beyond trading, and the player is fixed on the defending side.

note.zh: 在 WorkBuddy（编码智能体 Harness）中以 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017（High 档 · 思考强度「高」）一次生成，全程未调用任何 skill、插件或 MCP，未使用自定义系统提示词。产出为完整的 Three.js 工程（Bun 构建，bun install / bun run build；另附同一份源码构建的单文件 dist/index.html，476 KB）：片长 168 秒（在 360 秒硬上限内）、分五个章节的体素风格三维影片，讲章北海为推进辐射驱动而狙杀三名老航天的段落。全部视觉为代码生成的方块几何（人物由头、躯干、双臂、双腿的立方体拼成），不使用任何外部模型、贴图或 CDN。语音 cue 集中保存在一份结构化清单中，共 18 条，每条固定含 id、kind、speaker、text、delivery、start、end 七个字段；字幕按 `【说话者】文本` 固定格式在画面底部居中显示，并完全由该清单驱动。声音全部以 Web Audio 运行时合成：用程序生成的双声道脉冲响应（含四道墙面早期反射）做地下室卷积混响，另含车床切削、枪声、脚步、冬眠舱泄压嘶声、无线电提示音与低频环境层；真空段落按声学处理为静默，只保留航天服内的低频闷响与心跳。已验证：bun run build 通过；无头浏览器（Edge + SwiftShader）在 6 个时间点抽帧核对，字幕按时间轴依次出现、无页面错误、无失败请求。生成后修复六处缺陷：源码中误用 TypeScript 断言语法导致构建失败；房间尺寸小于镜头路径，相机穿墙后整帧全黑；车间与车库仅一盏筒灯而整体欠曝，补入环境光与两盏定向光；车库立柱按 1.2 米密排，把镜头糊成一片柱子，改为沿墙稀疏布置；车库镜头贴到倒地人物身上，拉远至 3.8–4.2 米。如实说明两点：(1) 提示词要求的「一并提供的原文」在仓库 cases.json 与文件树中均不存在，本片依据对该章节的通识记忆改编，台词为原创短片对白而非原文引用，已在 PR 中向维护者确认该前提是否可接受；(2) 几何高度简化，人物为纯方块、无面部与口型动画，真空段仅有静默与低频处理。
note.en: One-shot by DeepSeek V4.1 Flash 1017 (High effort) in the WorkBuddy coding-agent harness, with no skill, plugin or MCP server invoked and no custom system prompt. The artifact is a complete Three.js project built with Bun (bun install / bun run build, plus a 476 KB single-file dist/index.html from the same source): a 168-second voxel-style 3D film in five chapters (inside the 360-second cap) about Zhang Beihai assassinating three old-guard spaceflight figures to secure the radiation-drive programme. All visuals are code-generated block geometry, with characters built from cubes for head, torso, both arms and both legs, and no external models, textures or CDNs. The voice cues live in one structured manifest of 18 entries, each carrying exactly id, kind, speaker, text, delivery, start and end; the subtitles render bottom-centred in the fixed `【Speaker】Text` form and are driven entirely by that manifest. Every sound is synthesised at runtime with the Web Audio API: a procedural stereo impulse response (with four discrete wall slap-backs) drives a basement convolution reverb, joined by lathe cutting, gunshots, footsteps, cryo-chamber venting, radio beeps and a low ambience bed, while the vacuum passage is treated acoustically as silence carrying only the suit-conducted low thud and heartbeat. Verified: bun run build passes; a headless browser (Edge with SwiftShader) was sampled at six timestamps, where the subtitles appear in timeline order with no page errors and no failed requests. Six defects were fixed after generation: TypeScript assertion syntax left in the JavaScript source broke the build; the rooms were smaller than the camera path, so the camera ended up inside a wall and the frame went black; the workshop and garage were underlit by a single strip lamp and gained ambient plus two directional lights; the garage columns stood on a 1.2 m grid that turned the frame into a forest of pillars and are now sparse along the walls; and the garage camera sat on top of a falling body and was pulled back to 3.8-4.2 m. Two points are stated plainly: (1) the source passage the prompt refers to is not present in the repository's cases.json or file tree, so this film adapts the chapter from general knowledge, with original short dialogue rather than quoted text, and the PR asks the maintainer to confirm that premise; (2) the geometry is deliberately minimal, the figures are pure blocks with no facial or lip-sync animation, and the vacuum passage is carried only by silence and low-frequency treatment.
